description.zh:
知识库类型。
- TEXT：文档。
- STRUCTURED：结构化数据。
- IMAGE：图片。
- VIDEO：视频。
description.en:
The type of the knowledge base.

*   TEXT: Document.
*   STRUCTURED: Structured data.
*   IMAGE: Image.
*   VIDEO: Video.

description.zh: 使用 NextToken 方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。
description.en: When querying using NextToken, the maximum number of results returned each time.
The name of the knowledge base.

description.zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。
description.en: Used to mark the current starting position for reading; leaving it empty means starting from the beginning.

description.zh:
排序方式。

- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序。
description.en:
The order in which you want to sort the queried instances.

*   ASC: ascending order.
*   DESC: descending order.

description.zh: 当前页数。 取值范围：大于0。 默认值：1。如果同时传入MaxResults，则使用NextToken查询方式，忽略此字段值。
description.en: Current page number. Value range: greater than 0. Default value: 1. If MaxResults is passed in at the same time, the NextToken query method will be used, and this field value will be ignored.

description.zh: 每页查询的数量。如果同时传入 MaxResults，则以 MaxResults 数量为准。
description.en: The number of queries per page. If MaxResults is passed in at the same time, the quantity will be based on MaxResults.
Sorting field. Currently, only GmtCreateTime is supported.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
